$$

The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic tangent function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{artanh}⁡x)=\frac{1}{1-{x}^{2}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(4\operatorname{artanh}⁡(4x-1)) \\  & =4\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{artanh}⁡(4x-1)) \\  & =4\cdot \frac{1}{1-(4x-1)^{2}}\cdot (4x-1)^{′} \\  & =4\cdot \frac{1}{1-(16{x}^{2}-8x+1)}\cdot 4 \\  & =16\cdot \frac{1}{8x-16{x}^{2}} \\  & =16\cdot \frac{1}{8x(1-2x)} \\  & =\frac{2}{x(1-2x)}.\end{aligned}
$$
